crossRefs.note: “ ‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.
“ ‘If you walk contrary to me, and won’t listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to…
then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins.
then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins.
then Yahweh will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful, even great plagues, and of long duration…
Yahweh will not pardon him, but then Yahweh’s anger and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all the curse…
The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire?…
Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire…
But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell…
Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed…
for the great day of his wrath has come; and who is able to stand?”

translations.web: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?
translations.bsb: Who knows the power of Your anger? Your wrath matches the fear You are due.
translations.kjv: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.
translations.asv: Who knoweth the power of thine anger, And thy wrath according to the fear that is due unto thee?
